basic_details.job_title: DCPU Tiruppur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk, Office Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit Tiruppur (DCPU Tiruppur) has announced 2 temporary vacancies for Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts under Mission Vatsalya guidelines. Candidates can apply offline by submitting their completely filled application form with self-attested copies of educational and other certificates in person or by post to the District Child Protection Unit, Room No: 705, 7th Floor, District Collectorate Office, Tiruppur before 5:45 PM on 26 October 2026. faq.question: Q1. Are these posts temporary or permanent?
faq.answer: The notifications state that these positions are purely temporary on a monthly consolidated pay basis under Mission Vatsalya guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. Can applications be submitted online?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted either in person or sent by post to the District Collectorate Office, Tiruppur.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications and certificate copies along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
